Subject: Demo recap + POC plan — Redwood Inference & FinServX

Hi Anna / Tom,

Thanks again for taking time to run through the demo earlier today — really appreciate the context on your fraud-detection pipeline and the low-latency inference needs. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan so we can align on scope and timeline.

Demo highlights:
- Model types: transformer-based fraud classifier + candidate reranker (you confirmed 2 main flows)
- Latency requirement: 50–100 ms p95 per request (per our notes)
- Throughput: peak ~200 req/s, typical 60–80 req/s

Proposed 3-week POC (outline attached):
1) Week 0 (kickoff) — align success criteria, provide test dataset samples, share network requirements
2) Week 1 — baseline integration (endpoint setup, test dataset ingestion, run smoke tests)
3) Week 2 — workload testing & tuning (batching, KV caching, quantization profile)
4) Week 3 — evaluation, handoff, decision meeting

Success criteria (draft):
- Latency: p95 <= 120 ms for production-like traffic (goal 100 ms)
- Throughput: sustain 150 req/s for 10 minutes without errors
- Cost: per-token inference cost within agreed target compared to current baseline (we'll share a cost model)
- Quality: parity against your current classifier on held-out set (within 1–2% precision/recall)

Owners / asks:
- FinServX: provide a representative (anonymized) dataset + expected request distribution by 2026-05-24
- Redwood: provide POC environment, demo recording, config recommendations (Marissa + Dev)
- Technical POC owner on Redwood: David Kim (cc'd)

Next steps (please confirm):
- Confirm POC kickoff week (targeting week of 2026-05-27)
- Anna/Tom to confirm dataset and any legal/connector constraints
- We’ll share a short POC outline and network requirements (attached)

Attachments: redwood-poc-outline.pdf, network_requirements.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow-up if you want to walk the plan together.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Anna / Tom — adding a few technical notes ahead of kickoff so your infra team has visibility:

Network / infra highlights (see attached network_requirements.xlsx):
- Outbound only HTTPS to our control plane + specific inference endpoints (we can provide IP ranges for a short-term POC)
- Minimal ports: 443 only; optional SSH for troubleshooting if agreed

Environment / perf expectations:
- For the classifier + reranker in demo config, estimate ~0.6–0.9 GPU hours per 1k inference minutes for continuous testing (we’ll refine after we see sample payloads)
- We’ll instrument KV cache for prefix reuse — this typically reduces tokens-per-request by ~15–30% depending on payload overlap
- We recommend a small staging GPU (NVIDIA A10/A30 equivalent) for Week 1 integration, scale to 2x for Week 2 load testing

Data handling & security:
- POC uses ephemeral data stores; no long-term retention unless agreed
- We can enable VPC peering or temporary site-to-site VPN if required for the POC

I’ve attached network_requirements.xlsx for the infra team. Happy to jump on the kickoff call and walk through any questions.

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
